protocolPathCorrection.reason: Docker downstream truth-gate receipt path normalization only; no model/decoder/projector/scoring/selection change. Five DEVELOPMENT LINEAR acoustic streams sealed; no MIDI opened by failed invocation; no EVALUATION inference.

executionDomains.modelInference: Headed system-branded Chrome, hardware/default WebGPU, Windows research Node; no host Python
executionDomains.productProjectorAndStatistics: Deterministic research Node / authoritative TypeScript ledger, downstream of sealed acoustic publications

metricDenominators.overallVerdictAgreement: Selected counterfactual target groups and omitted target attacks; not every repeated background group.
metricDenominators.expectedStrikeRecall: Reference physically matchable expected strikes across scenarios; repeated source attacks are not independent recordings.
metricDenominators.extraPrecisionRecall: All finalized extras in each complete counterfactual replay, matched to physical residuals at fixed50ms; depends on artificial error prevalence.
metricDenominators.latency: Conditional on correctly classified targeted verdicts. Counts and incorrect/missed classifications retained separately; no zero-latency imputation. All-finalized background/incorrect-class distributions are also retained.
metricDenominators.extraTargetLatency: Physical omitted-attack coordinate is used for benchmark EXTRA latency; full projector audit retains model-estimated acoustic event coordinate.
metricDenominators.ownership: Half-open ownership of emitted acoustic coordinates; not a claim that a model can never duplicate a physical source attack across windows.

timerQuantization.interpretation: Measured sub-millisecond early starts, consistent with browser timer/clock quantization; exact cause was not separately instrumented. Raw offsets retained, without a fitted acceptance threshold or sub-millisecond hard-real-time claim.

auditDeadlineInterpretation: Group deadlineMs is the nominal group deadline; actual finality additionally waits ledger/wrong components. EXTRA deadlineMs retains the attack coordinate, not a claim-release cutoff. Its immutable release is evidenced by finalizationTimeMs, causal publication frontier, and LEDGER_RESIDUAL_AND_ALL_LEGAL_GROUP_CLAIMS_CLOSED reason in full audits.
limitations: Ten28s clips, only5 independent EVALUATION clips; no indefinite-session or natural pianist-error reliability claim.
No native microphone capture, UI-render or perceptual latency measured. Warmup/cold load occurs before capture origin.
Counterfactuals reuse source observations across separate hypothetical scores; ownership is globally one-to-one within each scenario ledger, not across independent replay experiments.
Zero observed critical errors and degenerate bootstrap intervals do not establish zero population risk. No non-inferiority margin or absolute UX SLO was fitted.
Configuration order is fixed and not thermally counterbalanced; no hardware-cause claim.
Same28s output coordinate interval for both resamplers; band-limited FIR uses frozen real source guard and includes conservative lookahead in scheduled readiness.
Raw audit deadline fields are not a proof of earliest possible finalization; actual immutable-release timestamps are reported.

Primary verdict finalization timestamps are logical publication-driven replay availability. Projector computation duration itself and UI rendering were not instrumented in this clock; these are not measured full end-to-end user-feedback latencies.
